duties.gap: Decision construction (constant removal, normal form, witness criterion with tree-model unravelling, type-elimination procedure with correctness and 2EXPTIME/EXPTIME running-time analysis, matching lower bounds) is written in full. The finite-model construction for GF is not complete in the handbook: the finite structure A+ is obtained only from Herwig's extension theorem, which is stated as an imported premise and not proved (proofboundary def:p02-w02-p02-035-herwig-import). Duty: supply a complete finite-model construction for satisfiable guarded sentences, including the construction of the finite extension A+ with properties (i) every partial isomorphism of A extends to an automorphism of A+ and (ii) every live tuple of A+ is moved into A by an automorphism, or another complete finite-model construction. Herwig's papers are not held (blocked_source).
